title: [M4] Bounded Walk image assignment and operator review workflow
description:

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Complete the first external-art assignment exercise against a work order declared in advance.

**Scope:** Walk declaration → supplied PNG/sheet batch mapping → after-preview → scoped composition approval and gap report.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Declare Walk actions/views/per-view frames and ordered layers before image import; illustrative eight-by-six counts are never imposed as quota.
- [x] Map supplied external images to exact action/view/frame/layer IDs, inspect after-preview and record operator approval on the canonical composition revision.
- [x] Missing/invalid/unapproved views or layers remain exact visible gaps; one supplied view can complete only its explicitly narrow scope, never the full profile.
- [x] Checklist, mappings, source/recipe hashes, preview fidelity and review survive reopen and are ready for M5 consumption.
- [x] No claim of playable compiled or native-verified output occurs at M4.

## Verification

Walk operator walkthrough with synthetic legally distributable supplied art, missing-view and stale-review checks; record scope and gap report.

Evidence packet: docs/evidence/rsf22/VERIFICATION.md
QA Review: docs/evidence/rsf22/QA_REVIEW.md (QA_PASS)
All 405 public tests, 36 private reference tests, and 10 walk integration tests passed. Isolated wheel distribution passed (DISTRIBUTION_CHECK_PASS).
Milestone M4 Gate: M4_ARTWORK_INGESTION_AND_PROCESSING_VERIFIED.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-21 (M4-03; task ID tnco42miae37x8m268gi6s4g)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** No art generation or video ingestion; M5 compiles and proves native playback.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence (add at QA handoff)

- Code changes / diff: Documented in docs/evidence/rsf22/implementation-manifest.json
- Test commands / exit statuses / artifact hashes: 10/10 walk integration tests, 405/405 public regression tests, 36/36 private tests, isolated wheel build and test pass.
- Milestone gates / limitations: Structural, coverage, visual, preview and native states remain separate.
